title: MemoryExportsCreateRequest
description: Start a space or subject export; returns a pending receipt and completes asynchronously (§7.0.3). With require_quiescent the space must be frozen and drained (pending_receipts == 0), otherwise INVALID_INPUT with details.reason "space_not_drained" (MEM-R023). Export is on the freeze allowlist, so SPACE_FROZEN never applies. Grant: transfer with coverage of the requested export scope. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

require_quiescent.description: Default false. True requires a frozen, drained space (MEM-R023); false yields a provider-consistent but write-racing snapshot (backups only).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
